reason: A web interface plugin that aggregates local token-usage events and presents daily usage as a configurable calendar heatmap with summary totals.

summaries.zh: 在新会话页面显示可配置配色和年份视图的每日 token 用量热力图及今日、本月和累计统计。
summaries.en: Displays a configurable daily token-usage heatmap with year selection and today, monthly, and all-time totals on the new-session screen.

capabilities: Reads token-usage samples from local session event logs
Aggregates and caches usage totals by day and model
Displays a calendar heatmap and summary totals in the web interface
Provides loopback HTTP endpoints for usage data and configuration
Persists display settings and a local usage cache
Refreshes displayed data periodically and on demand
